media:group.media:title: MYKITA | RIMOWA – THE REHEARSAL
media:group.media:description:
Nina Hoss and Leon Dame reunite for The Rehearsal, the latest MYKITA | RIMOWA campaign – a close-up study in shapeshifting, exploring the relationship between eyewear and identity.
The campaign accompanies a new chapter in the longstanding collaboration between MYKITA and RIMOWA, featuring latest additions to the HERITAGE and VISOR series.

media:group.media:title: A LIGHT TOUCH | MYKITA 2026/27 CAMPAIGN
media:group.media:description:
MYKITA presents A LIGHT TOUCH – a study in light and lightness, and the qualities that shape perception, design and experience.
The campaign explores the transformative effects of light through portraits and atmospheric studies. Diffused light, gentle reflections and subtle shifts in colour and texture reveal beauty gradually.
This sensitivity finds a parallel in our approach to eyewear: through material innovation and engineering, lightness shapes the experience of wearing as profoundly as light shapes the experience of seeing.
Featuring new releases for Autumn/Winter 2026 and Spring 2027.

media:group.media:title: MYKITA and RIMOWA Spring 2026 campaign
media:group.media:description:
MYKITA and RIMOWA present the Spring 2026 campaign introducing new eyewear additions
Starring German actress Nina Hoss and model Leon Dame, the campaign unfolds within a rehearsal space, reflecting the discipline and precision behind artistic expression and craft.
The release expands the HERITAGE series with the introduction of the Clay Green colourway — a tone-on-tone matte khaki palette paired with Raw Brown Gradient lenses — alongside the new MR006 aviator silhouette.
Designed in collaboration between Berlin and Cologne and handcrafted at MYKITA HAUS in Berlin, the collection combines MYKITA’s stainless steel eyewear engineering with RIMOWA’s signature aluminium design.
Explore the full collection at mykita.com

media:group.media:title: MYKITA + OAMC
media:group.media:description:
Presenting MYKITA + OAMC® – launching globally this week.
This meeting of design disciplines brings progressive utilitarian aesthetics to the eyewear realm. MYKITA and OAMC® are both known for pushing technical boundaries to achieve refined, purpose-driven products – a shared mindset that set the direction for the project from the start.
Read all about the process of the design collaboration between OAMC’s Luke Meier and MYKITA founder Moritz Krueger in our JOURNAL feature: https://mykita.com/en/journal/introducing-mykita-oamc

media:group.media:title: MYKITA Studio
media:group.media:description:
Presenting STUDIO 15 – a statement in deconstruction
The MYKITA STUDIO line is a conceptual design series for high-fashion eyewear – each edition exploring new forms, constructions and aesthetic directions.
STUDIO 15 pushes our ultra-minimal LESSRIM construction into sharper, graphic territory. Angular silhouettes, subtle art-deco elements and a principle of visual deconstruction define the concept. A strong statement for design-led eyewear enthusiasts.
Available now at MYKITA stores and selected partners worldwide – explore the capsule at mykita.com

media:group.media:title: MYKITA 2025/26 – COMPANION PIECES
media:group.media:description: MYKITA presents Companion Pieces, a meditation on nature and design, where nothing is superfluous. Nikki McClarron captures the 2025/26 collection in portraits of authentic expression, lightness, and clarity. Her refined analogue vision, with precise colour and form, creates photographs with a tactile realness. Paired with natural imagery, the series reflects a shared language of balance, function, and objects made exactly as they should be.

media:group.media:title: MYKITA | RIMOWA
media:group.media:description:
Two pioneers of German design and manufacturing join forces for an exclusive collaboration, redefining the concept of luxury eyewear for a life on the move.
The short film featuring actress Vicky Krieps presents a preview of the aesthetics. As Krieps showcases pieces from the new collection, she reunites with past and present versions of herself in the waiting room of a passport studio, with a familiar voice—Udo Kier—as the photographer.
Discover more at mykita.com/en/mykita-rimowa

media:group.media:title: MYKITA | RIMOWA Eyewear Collection
media:group.media:description:
Introducing MYKITA and RIMOWA, starring Udo Kier.
On April 10th, a new partnership will come to life with the launch of the MYKITA and RIMOWA eyewear collection – showcasing German engineering at its finest. Pioneers in their respective fields, there is a shared legacy of lightweight and timeless design – ensuring each piece is built to last.
Unveiled alongside Cologne-born German actor Udo Kier, known for his portrayal of sophisticated roles throughout his illustrious career, the new collection sees three new personas cross while Kier waits to have his passport photo taken, showcasing select pieces from the eyewear collection.

media:group.media:title: MYKITA CAMPAIGN 2024
media:group.media:description:
Unconventional perspectives, distinctive compositions, and a defined light presence all contribute to a strong mood and unique atmosphere, expressing the pure yet radical aesthetics of MYKITA’s visual identity.
In a combination of close-up and distance images, photographer Ben Beagent captures the essence of lightness, modern constructions, balanced silhouettes, and refined colour compositions that define the eyewear designs.
The Stockholm archipelago, with its crisp, clear light and raw scenery, provides an authentic, natural setting that reinforces the preference for pure, understated elegance and minimalist aesthetics.

media:group.media:title: ADVANCING DESIGN WITH CIRCULAR TECHNOLOGY
media:group.media:description:
The joint production from MYKITA and Eastman presents the sustainable material, Acetate Renew in an atmospheric short film celebrating nature’s capacity to inspire circular solutions for a viable future. In addition to showcasing molecular recycling – one of the most revolutionary technologies for a sustainable world – the film provides a look behind the scenes at MYKITA’s Modern Manufactory.
Thanks to Eastman & Eastman Renew Solutions for the inspiring collaboration, as well as our film team:
Model – Sadiq Desh Voice Over Artist – Alison Guberek Director – Harun Güler Production Company – Stink Films Sound Design – Nikolaus Kuczewski Colorist – Delfina Mayer
